title: bypass educational
name: Bypass educational — NN/g
rule: If an educational confirmation is shown for a new non-serious side effect, let the user turn off future repeats.
pass_when: Educational confirmation for a new non-serious side effect offers a way to turn off future repeats.
overview: Educational confirms for mild new side effects can be turned off later.
apply_when: First-time confirms that teach a non-serious side effect.
not_when: Serious irreversible confirms that must appear every time.
agent_hint: Add a don’t-show-again path on educational non-serious confirms.
description: Educational confirmations teach a new but non-serious side effect the first times it appears. Once people understand it, repeating the dialog becomes noise—so offer a way to turn off future repeats. Do not add a bypass to serious irreversible confirms that must stay mandatory every time. Scope this to teaching prompts for mild side effects, not to danger gates that protect destructive commits.
